metadata.short_desc: Reminds you when Genshin / HSR / ZZZ / Arknights / Endfield dailies are not finished
metadata.desc: AstrBot port of ResinLoop. Checks daily task progress from Miyoushe (Genshin, Honkai: Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero) and Skland (Arknights, Endfield), then pushes a reminder to subscribed chats. Includes stamina overflow and ending-activity alerts. Read-only: no check-in, no reward claiming, no game data modification.

push_targets.hint: Filled automatically by sending /日常 订阅 in a chat

accounts.hint: Prefer the QR login commands; manual entry is only for migration

resource_thresholds.hint: Alert when current >= threshold; 0 disables the alert for that game

webhooks.hint: Fill only the channels you use; empty channels are skipped
